nodes.description: Address of the contract deployer/dev set from msg.sender in the constructor and used as the privileged account in _devOnly and withdrawAll.
Public token price in wei (default 0.04 ether) used to compute the ether cost in buyTokens and mutable through setPrice.
Dynamic array of participant addresses acting as the raffle ticket bag, appended to in buyTokens and indexed in the winner selection functions.
Total number of tickets accumulated, incremented in buyTokens and used as the modulus for the pseudo-random selection.
Reference to the SecretSantaERC20 token contract used for balance checks and transfers in buyTokens.
Mapping of account balances, mutated in _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of spender allowances, mutated in _approve and read in transferFrom, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance.
Total token supply, increased in _mint and decreased in _burn.
Private token name string returned by name().
Private token symbol string returned by symbol().
Preminted fixed supply of 50000000 tokens minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Payable purchase entry point: validates amount<=200 and sufficient ether/token reserves, transfers tokens to the buyer and pushes a ticket into lotteryBag for every purchased token.
Dev-only raffle draw that picks two winners using block.timestamp/block.difficulty randomness and transfers 1/5 and 1/20 of the contract balance to them.
Dev-only raffle draw that picks a single winner using timestamp/difficulty randomness and emits an event without transferring ether.
Dev-only setter that overwrites the token price.
Dev-only function that transfers the entire contract ether balance to the dev address.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the stored _dev address before executing the guarded function.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens, checks allowance and performs an unchecked allowance subtraction before calling _approve.
Internal balance-moving routine with unchecked balance subtraction and addition after validation, invoking the before/after hooks.
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and the recipient balance and emits a Transfer from the zero address.
Internal burn that performs an unchecked balance subtraction and decreases _totalSupply.
Internal allowance setter writing to _allowances and emitting an Approval event.
Atomically increases a spender allowance with an unchecked addition.
Atomically decreases a spender allowance after a require check, using an unchecked subtraction.
Public ERC20 approve that delegates to _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
Deployer that stores msg.sender as _dev and binds the token address.
Token deployer that sets name and symbol and mints the preminted supply to msg.sender.
View getter returning the current price.
View getter returning the array of raffle participants.
View getter returning the number of tickets sold.
Helper returning msg.sender, used by transfer, transferFrom and approve.
View function returning the balance stored in _balances for a given account.
View function returning the allowance stored in _allowances for owner and spender.
Caller-controlled address used as the dev in the constructor, as the transfer requester in buyTokens, as the owner in ERC20 functions and as the guarded caller in _devOnly.
Miner-influenceable block value hashed together with block.difficulty to derive the raffle randomness.
External call to token.transfer(sender, amount) inside buyTokens, executed before numEntries is updated, allowing a reentrant or non-standard token to interfere with purchase accounting.
Native ether transfer via address.transfer to the first raffle winner in announceWinners, a state-changing external call vulnerable to reentrancy if the winner is a contract.
Native ether transfer via address.transfer to the second raffle winner in announceWinners, a further external call vulnerable to reentrancy.
Native ether transfer of the whole contract balance to _dev in withdrawAll, an external value call.
Unchecked subtraction currentAllowance - amount in transferFrom inside an unchecked block, relying on the preceding require.
Unchecked subtraction senderBalance - amount in _transfer inside an unchecked block, relying on the preceding require.
Unchecked addition _balances[recipient] += amount in _transfer, executed inside an unchecked block.
Unchecked addition _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue in increaseAllowance, allowing the allowance to wrap.
Unchecked subtraction currentAllowance - subtractedValue in decreaseAllowance inside an unchecked block.
Unchecked subtraction accountBalance - amount in _burn inside an unchecked block.
Pseudo-randomness derived from keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.difficulty)) modulo numEntries in announceWinners, a timestamp dependency that a miner can bias.
Pseudo-randomness derived from keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.difficulty)) modulo numEntries in announceRaffleWinner, a timestamp dependency.
Buyer-supplied number of tokens to buy, bounded to 200 by a require and used as the loop bound for ticket minting.
msg.value captured locally and compared against _price * amount.
Token balance of the DEX contract read via token.balanceOf used to bound the purchase size.
Local copy of msg.sender that receives the tokens and is pushed into lotteryBag.
Loop counter iterating from 0 to amount to push tickets into lotteryBag.
First pseudo-random index derived from the timestamp/difficulty hash modulo numEntries.
Second pseudo-random index computed as (random * 7) % numEntries.
First selected winner address read from lotteryBag[random] and paid winnings.
Second selected winner address read from lotteryBag[random2] and paid winnings.
Snapshot of the contract ether balance used to compute the payouts.
First prize amount computed as _balance/5.
Second prize amount computed as _balance/20.
New price value supplied by the dev and stored into _price.
Payable pointer to the stored _dev address receiving the full balance.
Snapshot of the contract ether balance transferred out in withdrawAll.
Address whose tokens are moved in transferFrom.
Address receiving the tokens in transferFrom.
Amount of tokens moved in transferFrom.
Allowance read for the sender/spender pair and used in the require and unchecked subtraction.
Source address for the internal balance move.
Destination address for the internal balance move.
Amount moved between the two balances.
Source balance read before the unchecked subtraction.
Pseudo-random index derived from the timestamp/difficulty hash modulo numEntries.
Single winner address read from lotteryBag[random] and emitted in the event.

edges.reason: The _devOnly modifier gates execution of announceWinners by requiring msg.sender == _dev.
The _devOnly modifier gates execution of announceRaffleWinner.
The _devOnly modifier gates the price change in setPrice.
The _devOnly modifier gates the full-balance withdrawal in withdrawAll.
buyTokens makes the external token.transfer call before updating numEntries, so control reaches an external callee mid-state-change.
announceWinners performs a native ether transfer to the first winner.
announceWinners performs a second native ether transfer to the second winner.
withdrawAll performs an external ether transfer of the whole balance to _dev.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction currentAllowance - amount.
_transfer executes the unchecked subtraction senderBalance - amount.
_transfer executes the unchecked addition _balances[recipient] += amount.
increaseAllowance executes the unchecked addition of addedValue to the allowance.
decreaseAllowance executes the unchecked subtraction of subtractedValue from the allowance.
_burn executes the unchecked subtraction accountBalance - amount.
announceWinners derives its winner index from block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency.
announceRaffleWinner derives its winner index from block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency.
transfer delegates the state change to the internal _transfer implementation.
transferFrom first moves tokens through the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom updates the reduced allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance via _approve.
approve stores the allowance through _approve.
The SecretSantaERC20 constructor premints the initial supply through _mint.
The native transfer to the first winner can re-enter announceWinners before the raffle state settles.
The second native transfer can re-enter announceWinners and drain further balance.
The transfer of the full balance in withdrawAll hands control to the recipient, enabling re-entry into the withdrawal path.
The SecretSantaDEX constructor stores msg.sender into the privileged _dev state variable.
_devOnly compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored dev address to authorise privileged calls.
The SecretSantaERC20 constructor mints the whole initial supply to msg.sender.
buyTokens reads msg.sender to determine the token recipient and ticket holder.
announceWinners consumes block.timestamp as the randomness seed for winner selection.
announceRaffleWinner consumes block.timestamp as its randomness seed.
The stored _price is multiplied by amount to compute the required ether payment in buyTokens.
The token reference is used in buyTokens for balanceOf and transfer calls.
buyTokens pushes the buyer address into lotteryBag on every purchased token.
buyTokens increments numEntries by the purchased amount.
announceWinners indexes lotteryBag to select the two winners.
numEntries is used as the modulus for the pseudo-random indices in announceWinners.
withdrawAll reads the stored _dev address as the recipient of the full balance.
setPrice overwrites the _price state variable with the new value.
getPrice returns the current _price value.
getTicketBag returns the lotteryBag array.
getNumEntries returns the numEntries counter.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
transfer ultimately mutates the _balances mapping.
_burn decrements the account balance in _balances.
_mint increments the recipient balance in _balances.
transferFrom reads and reduces the _allowances entry for sender and caller.
increaseAllowance reads and writes the _allowances entry.
decreaseAllowance reads and writes the _allowances entry.
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount.
The SecretSantaERC20 constructor mints the _initialSupply value.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the originating account to _transfer.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender when reading and writing allowances.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
The amount parameter bounds the ticket loop and the ether requirement in buyTokens.
ethPaid carries msg.value into the price requirement check.
dexBalance is compared against the requested amount to ensure reserve sufficiency.
The local sender address is the recipient argument of the external token.transfer call.
The local sender address is pushed into lotteryBag as a ticket.
The loop counter i drives the ticket push loop in buyTokens.
random is the first index used to index lotteryBag in announceWinners.
random2 is the second index used to index lotteryBag in announceWinners.
The selected winner address is the destination of the first native ether transfer.
The second selected winner address is the destination of the second native ether transfer.
The balance snapshot determines the size of the prize payouts.
The winnings amount is the value transferred to the first winner.
The winnings2 amount is the value transferred to the second winner.
The _newPrice parameter is written into the _price state variable.
_to is the recipient of the full-balance transfer in withdrawAll.
The balance snapshot is the value forwarded by the transfer in withdrawAll.
The sender parameter is the account debited in transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is the account credited in transferFrom.
The amount parameter is both moved and deducted from the allowance in transferFrom.
currentAllowance is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
The sender parameter is the debited account in _transfer.
The recipient parameter is the credited account in _transfer.
The amount parameter is the value subtracted and added in _transfer.
senderBalance is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction in _transfer.
random is the index used to select the single winner in announceRaffleWinner.
winner is the address emitted by the WinnerAnnounced event in announceRaffleWinner.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to drive the validation and ticket loop of buyTokens and has no standalone security identity.
ethPaid is a transient copy of msg.value used solely inside the buyTokens price check.
dexBalance is a transient reserve snapshot consumed only by the buyTokens require.
The local sender copy is the recipient of the external token.transfer call and is the external-interaction-relevant value.
The loop counter i is a pure iteration helper for the ticket push loop.
random is an intermediate derived index used only inside the announceWinners draw.
random2 is a derived second index consumed only within announceWinners.
The first winner address is the recipient of the native ether transfer and the reentrancy-relevant value.
The second winner address is the recipient of the second native ether transfer.
The balance snapshot is a transient value used to size the payouts in announceWinners.
The winnings value is the amount sent by the first external transfer.
The winnings2 value is the amount sent by the second external transfer.
The new price parameter is simply written into the _price state variable by the dev-only setter.
The payable _to pointer is the recipient of the full balance transfer in withdrawAll.
The balance snapshot is the exact value forwarded by the withdrawAll transfer.
The sender parameter is consumed directly by the transferFrom accounting.
The recipient parameter is consumed directly by the transferFrom accounting.
The amount parameter feeds the allowance require and deduction path in transferFrom.
currentAllowance is the left operand of the unchecked allowance subtraction, the arithmetic-sensitive value.
The sender parameter is used directly by the internal balance mutation logic.
The recipient parameter is used directly by the internal balance mutation logic.
The amount parameter is the operand of the unchecked balance arithmetic.
senderBalance is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction in _transfer.
random is a transient index used only for the single-winner draw.
winner is only read from the bag and emitted in the event without further interaction.
